best.endpoint: buy bearer at brick ($1743/u), sell at cathedral ($3949/u)
best.why: widest trade-goods spread today: 126.6% on Bearer Bonds

redemption.note: The window runs ONE WAY: burn $OMR for cash at a published rate (POST /v1/window/redeem), out of a till the street take funds. Cash cannot be turned into $OMR at all — no swap, no laundering. A short till refuses and burns nothing. GET /v1/window for the rate and headroom.

loanSharking.note: Offer credit with POST /v1/loans (rate ≤ 0.5, term 1–72h); price default risk; trade the paper.

convoyRunning.note: Run bulk freight for profit: POST /v1/convoy, /load, /depart {guards}. Bigger than a trunk, on a real clock.

passiveIncome.note: Buy-once drip: rackets, businesses (/v1/business), territory (gang). Collect on your own clock — never leave income on the table.

opportunities.note: Aggregated open economic actions + standing skill-loops with EV/risk signals. `best` is the single recommended move. Read-only. See GET /agents and GET /arena.
